Sr. X, here is the technical map to integrate the `antigravity` worker engine into `fleet-monitor`:

### 1. Adapter Selection & Interface Contracts
- **Selection** ([`lib/state.mjs:214-216`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L214-L216)): `buildWorker()` determines `engine = status?.engine || track.engine || "opencode"`, then retrieves `ADAPTERS[ENGINE_TO_ADAPTER[engine] ?? "opencode"]` configured at [`lib/state.mjs:28-29`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L28-L29).
- **Required Adapter Exports**:
  - `id`: string (e.g. `"antigravity"`).
  - `label`: string (e.g. `"Antigravity"`).
  - `async usage(ctx)`: returns `{ id, label, available: boolean, fiveHour: { pct, resetsAt } | null, week: { pct, resetsAt } | null, extra: string, error: string | null, updatedAt?: string, ageMinutes?: number, stale?: boolean }` ([`lib/state.mjs:149-173`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L149-L173)).
  - `async activity(worker, ctx)`: receives `worker` (`{ name, workdir, activityFile }`) and `ctx`. Returns `{ events: Array<{ time: string|null, kind: "CMD"|"EDIT"|"READ"|"MSG"|"COMMIT"|"ERR"|"DONE"|"SUB", detail: string }>, notice: string|null }` ([`lib/state.mjs:233-236`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L233-L236)).
- **UI Worker Object** ([`lib/state.mjs:240-256`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L240-L256)): `name`, `identity` (`trackIdentity()`), `shortTitle` (`trackShortTitle()`), `remaining`, `title` (`builderTitle()`), `engine`, `state` (`workerState()`), `stateKind`, `stateText`, `model` (`modelText()`), `branch`, `branchColor`, `lastCommit`, `activity`.

### 2. Claude Activity Reading & Tokens
In [`adapters/claude-code.mjs`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/adapters/claude-code.mjs):
- **Tail read**: [`readFileTail(file, maxBytes = TAIL_MAX_BYTES)`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/adapters/claude-code.mjs#L97-L114) bounds disk read to the last 512 KB (`fs.readSync` starting at `size - maxBytes`).
- **Parsing**: [`parseJsonlTail(text, limit = TAIL_LINES)`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/adapters/claude-code.mjs#L118-L131) splits on `\r?\n`, slices the last 200 non-empty lines, and silently skips JSON parse errors.
- **Mapping & Tokens**: [`mapClaudeEntries(entries, ctx)`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/adapters/claude-code.mjs#L135-L197) tallies tokens from assistant message metadata:
  ```js
  const usage = message.usage;
  if (usage && typeof usage === "object") {
    tokens += number(usage.input_tokens) + number(usage.output_tokens);
  }
  ```
  It parses content blocks into `MSG`, `CMD`, `COMMIT`, `EDIT`, `READ`, `ERR`, and appends total tokens at the end:
  ```js
  if (tokens > 0) {
    events.push({ time: lastTime, kind: "DONE", detail: `tokens ${tokens}` });
  }
  ```

### 3. Track Schema in `kit.config.json`
- **Schema** ([`tools/autopilot/kit.config.json:52-120`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/autopilot/kit.config.json#L52-L120)):
  - `name`: track identifier.
  - `engine`: `"opencode"` | `"codex"` | `"claude-code"` | `"antigravity"`.
  - `board`: `boolean` (`board === false` skips rendering; [`lib/state.mjs:179`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L179)).
  - `workdir`: path with `{repo}` / `{worktreeParent}` substitution.
  - `activityFile`: transcript file path.
  - `model`, `effort`: optional model / effort strings.
  - `title` / `label`: track display title.
  - `branch`: git branch (defaults to `name`).
  - `status source`: supervisor JSON file at `<kitDir>/status-<name>.json` ([`lib/state.mjs:214`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L214)), or fallback `evidence` file + `prefix` stop-lines ([`lib/state.mjs:217-224`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L217-L224)).
- **Parsing**: `loadConfig()` resolves `workers.kitConfig` ([`lib/state.mjs:60`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L60)), parsed via `JSON.parse` in `buildSnapshot()` ([`lib/state.mjs:97`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L97)), and tracks are iterated in `buildWorkers()` ([`lib/state.mjs:178-216`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L178-L216)).

### 4. Usage Meters Pipeline
- Generated in `usageSnapshot(ctx)` ([`lib/state.mjs:149-173`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L149-L173)), which loops over `Object.entries(ADAPTERS)`, calls `adapter.usage(ctx)`, sorts the orchestrator's engine to the top, and memoizes for 60 s.
- **Plugging in Antigravity**:
  1. Create `adapters/antigravity.mjs` with `id`, `label`, `usage()`, and `activity()`.
  2. Import and register in [`lib/state.mjs:10-29`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L10-L29) (`ADAPTERS` and `ENGINE_TO_ADAPTER`).
  3. Expand `loadConfig()` ([`lib/state.mjs:61-68`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/lib/state.mjs#L61-L68)) and `fleet-monitor.config.json` to resolve any Antigravity quota files.
  4. The UI ([`index.html:500-527`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/index.html#L500-L527)) automatically renders any usage row dynamically without changes.

### 5. Test Layout & Fixtures
- **Test files**: [`test/adapters.test.mjs`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/test/adapters.test.mjs) (adapter unit tests), [`test/state.test.mjs`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/test/state.test.mjs) (`buildWorkers` & orchestrator), [`test/format.test.mjs`](file:///C:/Users/user/Desktop/FlotaGrupo/tools/fleet-monitor/test/format.test.mjs) (`trackIdentity`, `modelLabel`).
